correctness.rationale: Read exact RESULT.md and carry-automaton verify.py. The digit sum identity s2(n+t)−s2(n)=h−K(n,t) is exact for carries K. In any accepted configuration K≤h, a carry launched at one occupied bit cannot reach the next occupied position at distance at least h+1. Hence separate bit windows e_j..e_j+h produce independent geometric isolated chains L_j with P(L=ℓ)=2^{-ℓ-1}, and {K≤h} equals {∑_j min(L_j,h+1)≤h}. The sum of h independent geometric variables is negative-binomial, with P(sum≤h)=P(Bin(2h,1/2)≥h), giving the central-binomial formula. Uniform fixed-length binary prefixes and exponentially vanishing carry tails establish natural density for fixed t. Independent exact rational carry DP including tail verified 15 isolated examples h=1..5. The finite tests do not prove all h or gaps.

value.rationale: Cusick digit-sum correlations are natural arithmetic densities. A universal finite separation condition causes exact stabilization of a density across every support pattern of a specified weight; the closed central-binomial law and asymptotic furnish a structural family, not a one-off computation. It is not the known universal positivity bound or the large-weight minimum.

final_claim: For h≥3, t=∑_{j=1}^h 2^{e_j} with e_{j+1}−e_j≥h+1, the natural density of s2(n+t)≥s2(n) exists and equals 1/2+binom(2h,h)/(2·4^h), independent of occupied positions; bias asymptotic is 1/(2√(πh)).
limitations: Sufficient separation threshold only; no claim it is necessary or minimal for every weight; t is fixed before density limit.
